description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK and DEF +30% (25s)], [Switch Draw Mode II (Fire, Ice)], [Awoken Lion], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Spellblade +30% Boost (15s)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lion
description.text: Ice and Fire abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Ice and Fire abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Draw & Stock after using two Ice or Fire abilities

description.name: Draw & Stock
description.text: One single attack (3.94) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Switch Draw Mode II (Fire, Ice)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
